---
title: "Revealjs table of contents"
format: revealjs
toc: true
# Quarto 1 adds a horizontal `<section id="TOC">` slide after the title
# slide (`toc-slide.html`), with reveal hash links (`#/id`, `id="/toc-id"`).
# `.unlisted` slides are left out; headings below the slide level are listed.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div.slides > section#title-slide + section#TOC > nav[role='doc-toc'] > h2#toc-title",
            "section#TOC a[href='#/section-a'][id='/toc-section-a']",
            "section#TOC li > ul > li > a[href='#/custom-id']",
            "section#TOC a[href='#/sub-heading']",
          ]
        - ["section#TOC a[href='#/hidden']"]
---

# Section A

## Slide one

Text.

## Slide two {#custom-id}

### Sub heading

Not a slide.

## Hidden {.unlisted}

Text.
